EN 16931 code lists: declared and implemented

25 effective dates, 2019-03-15 to 2026-05-15, 22 validator releases

The European Commission declares the codes an EN 16931 invoice may use, three ways per release: as a spreadsheet, as Genericode files, and as the change notes on the spreadsheet's Index sheet. The CEN validator implements them in its BR-CL rules. This page checks that the three declarations agree, and that the validator implements what is declared. How it works

At a glance: 2026-05-15 · code lists 17_2026-05-15 · validator 1.3.16
